name: Trendline
description: Represents a trendline in a chart.
remarks: A trendline shows the trend, or direction, of data in a series. The Trendline object is a member of the Trendlines collection. The Trendlines collection contains all the Trendline objects for a single series.
example:
With ActiveDocument.InlineShapes(1)
 If .HasChart Then
 .Chart.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines(1).Type = xlMovingAvg
 End If
End With

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent for the specified object. Read-only Object.

properties.name: Border
properties.description: Returns the border of the object. Read-only ChartBorder.

properties.name: DataLabel
properties.description: Returns the data label that is associated with the trendline. Read-only DataLabel.

properties.name: DisplayEquation
properties.description: True if the equation for the trendline is displayed on the chart (in the same data label as the R-squared value). Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: DisplayRSquared
properties.description: True if the R-squared value of the trendline is displayed on the chart (in the same data label as the equation). Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: Index
properties.description: Returns the index number of the object within the collection of similar objects. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Intercept
properties.description: Returns or sets the point where the trendline crosses the value axis. Read/write Double.

properties.name: InterceptIsAuto
properties.description: True if the point where the trendline crosses the value axis is automatically determined by the regression. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: Name
properties.description: Returns or sets name of the object. Read/write String.

properties.name: NameIsAuto
properties.description: True if Microsoft Word automatically determines the name of the trendline. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: Order
properties.description: Returns or sets the trendline order (an integer greater than 1) when the trendline type is xlPolynomial. Read/write Long.

properties.name: Period
properties.description: Returns or sets the period for the moving-average trendline. Read/write Long.

properties.name: Type
properties.description: Returns or sets the trendline type. Read/write XlTrendlineType.

properties.name: Format
properties.description: Returns the line, fill, and effect formatting for the object. Read-only ChartFormat.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: When used without an object qualifier, returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Word application. When used with an object qualifier, returns an Application object that represents the creator of the specified object (you can use this property with an Automation object to return the application of that object). Read-only.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the specified object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Backward2
properties.description: Returns or sets the number of periods (or units on a scatter chart) that the trendline extends backward. Read/write Double.

properties.name: Forward2
properties.description: Returns or sets the number of periods (or units on a scatter chart) that the trendline extends forward. Read/write Double.

methods.name: ClearFormats
methods.description: Clears the formatting of the object.

methods.name: SetProperty
methods.signature: SetProperty(ID As String, Value As Variant)
